title: Scattered gradient cards

techniques.name: Die-cut gradient card

path.label: Reading path
path.note: The table’s overlay that joins the cards in reading order.

stock.label: Stock tone
stock.note: How much of the stock’s own tone is laid over each print, as a share of the page’s own. Lower shows more of the printed field.

contour.label: Contour
contour.note: How hard the field snaps through its middle tone into a contour edge, as a multiple of the page’s own. Low is a soft blend.

warp.label: Warp
warp.note: How far the noise folds the field back on itself, as a multiple of the page’s own.

grain.label: Grain
grain.note: The per-pixel grain the field is printed with, as a multiple of the page’s own (a few levels).

arr_seed.label: Arrangement
arr_seed.note: Deals another arrangement of the scatter (the table’s “Another arrangement”).

techniques.implementation: A soft multi-stop gradient fills a card cut to an arch, a step or a notch; a large number sits in the cut. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
